coordination.label: OCHA
coordination.ocha_plan: République Démocratique du Congo Besoins Humanitaires et Plan de Réponse 2026 (HNRP)
coordination.note: HNRP (OCHA). No 2026 UNHCR in-country RRP chapter found; DRC refugees/IDPs are covered in the HNRP and UNHCR's own Global Appeal DRC situation chapter, which is not an RRP.

cwg_reliefweb.last_update_basis: latest document posted (CWG RDC 4W December 2024); page shows no updated stamp
cwg_reliefweb.contacts_basis: CALP West and Central Africa CWG leads report (Jul 2026); the ReliefWeb page itself lists no contacts. REACH gives technical support without a lead role.
cwg_reliefweb.note: Page lists 4W reports Jan 2024 to Dec 2024 and ToRs only; no dashboard, no minutes, no 2025-2026 items. National CWG plus regional groups (Goma, Bukavu, Kalemie, Kananga) and provincial groups (Bunia, Tshikapa).

cva_delivered_usd.note: USD 76.4M delivered to 3.6M people across eastern DRC in 2024 per CWG 4W data as cited by Mercy Corps; 4W is partial and 2023 (USD 98.7M) is not comparable. No 2025 total found.

mpc_delivered_usd.note: No USD MPC total found. The 4W summaries on the CWG page give MPC shares only (e.g. about 59% multipurpose in Dec 2024), without the USD value in the text read.

fsps.name: Trust Merchant Bank (TMB)
fsps.evidence: UNHCR cash snapshot to 31 Mar 2026 lists TMB for direct payments and mobile counters; Mercy Corps (Apr 2025) says banks handled 71% of NGO cash transfers in North Kivu in 2024, primarily TMB and Ecobank.

fsps.name: Ecobank
fsps.evidence: Named with TMB as the main banks for NGO cash transfers in North Kivu in 2024 (CWG 4W data); banks in M23-held areas were ordered closed in Jan 2025.

fsps.name: M-Pesa (Vodacash / Vodacom)
fsps.evidence: Listed as FSP in UNHCR DRC cash snapshot to 31 Mar 2026; also named as an example platform in an IOM Oct 2026 RFP.

fsps.name: Pepele Mobile
fsps.evidence: Listed as FSP in UNHCR DRC cash snapshot to 31 Mar 2026.

fsps.name: Airtel Money
fsps.evidence: Only named as an example mobile money platform in IOM's Oct 2026 RFP (Lot 2); use by humanitarians not confirmed in a source read.

fsps.name: Orange Money
fsps.evidence: Only named as an example platform in IOM's Oct 2026 RFP (Lot 2); use not confirmed.

fsps.name: Africell Money
fsps.evidence: Only named as an example platform in IOM's Oct 2026 RFP (Lot 2); use not confirmed.

fsps.name: COOPEC savings cooperatives (unnamed)
fsps.evidence: Cooperatives handled 8% of NGO transfers in North Kivu and 20% in South Kivu in 2024; no individual cooperative named.
